Package org.uma.evolver.cli.evaluation

Class EvaluationServer

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.cli.evaluation.EvaluationServer
public final class EvaluationServer extends Object
Evaluates configurations of a base-level algorithm on the problems of a base-level file, through an HTTP API, so that external configurators (SMAC3, irace) run the same experiments as Evolver's training without starting a Java virtual machine for each one.

The base-level file (the baseLevel of a training request) gives the algorithm, its parameter space, the problems with their reference fronts and evaluations, the number of runs and the quality indicators. Each problem gets a MetaOptimizationProblem of its own, whose evaluateConfiguration computes the indicators exactly as a training does (the median over the runs of the indicators of the non-dominated front, normalized with the reference front). The evaluations run in a pool of threads, as Evolver's parallel meta-optimizers run them; jMetal's random generator is shared by the threads, so the seed that a client sends is recorded but does not make an evaluation reproducible.

The API, on the loopback interface only:

  • POST /evaluate, with a JSON body {"configuration": "--name value ...", "problem": "ZDT4", "tool": "smac", "seed": 7} (tool and seed are optional): the indicators of the configuration on the problem, {"problem": "ZDT4", "EP": ..., "NHV": ..., "timeMs": ...}, or, with ?cost=sum, their sum as plain text (for irace, which minimizes one value). A configuration that fails gets status 422 and the error;
  • GET /health: ok;
  • GET /status: what the server is doing;
  • POST /shutdown: stops accepting evaluations, waits for those in progress and stops.

Every evaluation is appended to a CSV log ( Index,ElapsedMs,Tool,Problem,Seed,<indicators>, TimeMs,Configuration), from which the convergence of a configurator can be plotted.

      public EvaluationServer(String baseLevelFile, int port, int threads, Path logFile) throws IOException
      Builds the server, without starting it.
      Parameters:
      baseLevelFile - the base-level file: a name of baseLevelConfigurations/ or a path
      port - the port, on the loopback interface (0 for any free one)
      threads - the number of evaluations that run at the same time
      logFile - the CSV log of the evaluations (appended if it exists)
